subject.title: chore(deps): bump the actions group across 1 directory with 14 updates

question: Should these 14 executable action upgrades be accepted as one grouped update after an exact-head rebase, or should the credential, Codex, scanning, and release actions be reviewed and landed separately?
rationale: The patch is mechanically narrow and SHA-pinned, but several updated actions execute with secrets or write permissions, making the acceptable review and rollout granularity an ownership decision rather than a code-correctness inference.

options.title: Verify and land grouped
options.body: Rebase the PR, review the sensitive upstream action changes, and merge the grouped update after the exact head clears the relevant gates.

options.title: Split sensitive actions
options.body: Separate credential, Codex, CodeQL, and Docker publishing upgrades into smaller PRs when maintainers want isolated rollout and rollback evidence.

recommendation.title: Verify and land grouped
recommendation.body: Rebase the PR, review the sensitive upstream action changes, and merge the grouped update after the exact head clears the relevant gates.

likelyOwner.reason: This handle is the clearest available release and automation routing candidate and was explicitly brought into this PR's timeline.
